title: GOV-0014: main is red at 0b88c74 -- the composed-tree gate cannot see its own tests
problem:
## Observed
The push-to-`main` run for `0b88c74` (run 33104985912) fails 8 tests in `tests/test_badf_compose.py`, all with the same shape: the fixture commits the working tree as the candidate, and on `main` after the merge the working tree **is** `origin/main` — `git commit` has nothing to commit and raises. PR #39's runs were green twice over: the normal suite ran on a branch whose tree differed from `main`, and the **composed-tree gate skipped the compose tests inside the composed run** (it refuses to nest), so the one place that reproduces the post-merge world could not see the tests that break there.

## Expected
1. The compose fixture must produce a candidate that differs from its base **by construction**, whatever the relationship between the working tree and `origin/main`.
2. The composed-tree gate must run its own tests in the composed world. Refusing to nest was one level too strict: allow depth 1 (the composed suite runs the compose tests, each of which composes with a restricted pattern at depth 2, where the compose tests are skipped). A gate that skips itself has a blind spot exactly the size of itself.

## Evidence
`gh api repos/bstBizEra/badf/actions/runs/33104985912 --jq .conclusion` → `failure`. Pristine clone of `0b88c74`: `unittest` → 306 run, 8 errors (`test_ci_shape…`, `test_composed_clone_carries…`, `test_green_candidate…`, `test_message_naming…`, `test_message_without…`, `test_refuses_to_nest`, `test_unreachable_candidate…`, `test_writes_nothing…`). The three compose tests that pass are the three whose candidate edits a file before committing.

## Unknowns
None. Second occurrence of the "fixture depends on ledger state" class after #31; the first was the state the merge itself changes, this one is the tree being equal to it.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0025` — hot-fix through the loop: fixture adds a marker file to every candidate; `BADF_COMPOSE_DEPTH` replaces `BADF_COMPOSE_INNER` (refuse at depth ≥ 2); the branch's own composed run, now exercising the compose tests in the composed world, is the regression proof.

discovered-by: BADF-WP-0024 (post-merge) · status: DISCOVERED · severity: main red
note: Body exported verbatim and digest-bound. Hot-fix for a red main caused by BADF-WP-0024's own fixture and its refuse-to-nest rule; authority: the operator's standing in-session delegation. Worked as BADF-WP-0025.
